Verification

  • 253 native unit tests pass. Cancellation and cache retry regressions fail on f705184d and pass after the fixes.
  • 815 source-contract cases pass; project generation, zero style drift, 82/82 audit coverage and shared WisconsinKiosk simulator compilation pass.
  • Wrapped UI regression fails before the fix and passes after it. Student QR-copy regression fails before the fix and passes after fixture foreground identity is kept as Student.
  • Independent reviewers rechecked the four production fixes and found no remaining actionable defects.

Things to know

  • Fixture simulator proof does not claim authenticated server, camera, Siri, APNs, physical-device or App Store acceptance.
  • Remote CI and the current-head automated review remain separate merge gates.
  • Managed preview provisioning currently fails at the repository’s nine-preview capacity guard. No cleanup or infrastructure setting was changed.
